allow: PowerShell($conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $conns | ForEach-Object { $p = Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "PID=$\($_.OwningProcess\) Name=$\($p.ProcessName\) Started=$\($p.StartTime\)" })

PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 27556 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "PID=$\($_.OwningProcess\)" })
PowerShell(taskkill /F /PID 27556 2>&1; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { "PID=$\($_.OwningProcess\)" })
